boundary_atlas.complex_or_outside: complex m or real m outside [0,1] is outside the frozen self-adjoint Jacobi convention
boundary_atlas.free_face: m=0 gives -d2/dx2, the finite gap closes, and all positive folded-zone contacts are closed
boundary_atlas.modulus_sign: k maps to -k without changing m or the operator
boundary_atlas.soliton_limit: m tends upward to one, K tends to infinity, and the potential tends to 2-2*sech(x)^2 with isolated level 1 and continuum [2,infinity)
boundary_atlas.translation: x maps to x+x0 gives a unitarily equivalent periodic operator

collision_boundary.C221: the cubic-NLS soliton Hessian is nonperiodic and does not have a two-band Bloch decomposition
collision_boundary.C231: the Allen-Cahn front linearization is a nonperiodic Poschl-Teller operator
collision_boundary.C262: the square-wave Hill atlas has piecewise-constant transfer matrices rather than an elliptic finite-gap commuting operator
collision_boundary.C327: the Kronig-Penney delta comb is singular and is not the smooth one-gap Lame potential

model.fiber_convention: periodic multiplier +1 and antiperiodic multiplier -1 over 2*K(m)

nonclaims: no rational-prime or prime-power carrier is introduced
the cubic finite-gap curve is not a target Euler product or target determinant
no root number, automorphy, target functional equation, divisor, or zero match is claimed
the self-adjoint Lame operator is not claimed to be a Hilbert-Polya operator
finite rational-modulus rows do not prove closure of every higher spectral gap

theorem_contract.band_edges: dn, cn, sn have energies m, 1, 1+m; dn is periodic and cn,sn are antiperiodic over 2K
theorem_contract.boundaries: m=0 is free; m tends to one is the shifted Poschl-Teller soliton limit; translations are unitarily equivalent
theorem_contract.completeness: fiber skew-adjointness excludes R(E)<0; simultaneous Bloch solutions and their Wronskian put every R(E)>=0 on the spectrum
theorem_contract.fiber_skew_adjointness: on D(A_theta)=H^3_theta, periodic coefficients and common quasi-periodic phase cancel every endpoint term, so A_theta is skew-adjoint
theorem_contract.gap_count: the only finite open gap is (1,1+m); every higher gap is closed
theorem_contract.self_adjointness: H_m on H^2(R) is self-adjoint and bounded below
theorem_contract.spectral_type: the real periodic operator has purely absolutely continuous spectrum
